Game edits come from hueponik's WipEout 3 Special Edition patches:
https://codeberg.org/hueponik/wip3out-patches

This package does not redistribute the disc. It stores sparse guarded writes converted from the published xdelta against a verified SCES-02845 Track 01 dump. 1.0.14 forces gSimVblankSkip=2 from SimVblankGate entry (pre-CPS) plus VBlank backup. Hueponik's 50→60 timing scales stay for NTSC physics.
Mutually exclusive with `wipeout3.enhancement.framerate-120`.
